nodes.name: Intake and logging of counterparty's draft
nodes.rationale: This task involves data entry which can be fully automated by AI systems.

nodes.name: Clause comparison against standard playbook
nodes.rationale: AI can assist in drafting and flagging deviations, but human judgment is needed for final decisions.

nodes.name: Drafting proposed redlines for non-standard clauses
nodes.rationale: AI can generate drafts, but a human must review and finalize the redlines.

nodes.name: Review of high-risk clauses
nodes.rationale: This task requires human judgment and expertise that cannot be automated.

nodes.name: Emailing negotiated changes to counterparty
nodes.rationale: AI can assist in drafting emails, but human oversight is necessary for context and final approval.

nodes.name: Filing final executed copy in document repository
nodes.rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves document management.

nodes.name: Tracking key dates like renewal and expiry
nodes.rationale: This task requires ongoing human attention and cannot be fully automated.
